english.title: Keeper of cat fail to comply with notice to get cat microchipped within 21 days - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the keeper of a cat, namely **(..IDENTIFY CAT..), and having been served with a notice under regulation 13(2) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023 on **(..SPECIFY DATE NOTICE SERVED..) by **(.. SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), an authorised person under those regulations, failed to have that cat microchipped within 21 days
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13(2) and 14(2)(e) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
